title: A latch that cannot learn
notes: With w = 1.5 the plain RNN holds on to the cat: h climbs to 0.86 and stays there. Yet word 1's pull is 0.0023 by slept, because in that flat part of tanh every slope 1.5 × (1 − 0.86²) is about 0.4. Remembering and learning to remember are not the same thing.
ops: cat sat on the mat and it slept
